relay_invalid_input.message: The relay request or settings are invalid.
relay_invalid_input.remediation: Check the relay URL, settings and request limits.

relay_sender_forbidden.message: This page or session cannot send this relay request.
relay_sender_forbidden.remediation: Use the local control window or restart the selected chat source.

relay_settings_corrupt.message: Saved relay settings could not be validated.
relay_settings_corrupt.remediation: Explicitly restore initial settings from the control window. The original file is preserved.

relay_settings_save_failed.message: Relay settings could not be saved.
relay_settings_save_failed.remediation: Check local storage permissions and capacity before saving again.

relay_port_unavailable.message: The configured overlay port could not be opened.
relay_port_unavailable.remediation: Choose another overlay port or release the configured port, then save settings.

relay_feature_unavailable.message: This relay feature is not available in this phase.
relay_feature_unavailable.remediation: Use an existing loopback llama server. Model installation and managed startup require a later phase.

invalid_input.message: Text must contain 1–1000 characters and no extra fields.
invalid_input.remediation: Check the input and try again.

invalid_json.message: Request body must be valid JSON.

writes_disabled.message: Writes are disabled in this environment.
writes_disabled.remediation: Use an environment that explicitly permits writes.

permission_denied.message: Access to the requested host was not granted.
permission_denied.remediation: Grant the host permission when prompted, or choose a permitted host.

sender_forbidden.message: Only the extension's own pages may make this request.
sender_forbidden.remediation: Send the request from the side panel or another extension page.

not_found.message: Note, route or selected feature not found.
not_found.remediation: Check the target identifier and selected features.

unavailable.remediation: Check the previous operation's outcome before retrying.

cancelled.remediation: Start a new operation only when requested.

internal_error.message: The operation could not be completed.
internal_error.remediation: Investigate the diagnostic identifier; verify writes before retrying.
